title: Reconcile and migrate selected operational records
description: Translate only supported selected source records with explicit preservation and disposition; migration is distinct from restoring an already supported backup.
inputs: Selected original records, formats and content identities
Explicit disposition and supported target contract
preconditions: The requested scope and applicable action authority are explicit.
outputs: Coherent migrated scope with original-source provenance
Archival exclusions and unresolved dependency/conflict report
behavior: Before publication, migration identifies selected source content and identities and classifies each record as supported for import, retained archival evidence, or blocked pending disposition; counts alone do not establish semantic equivalence.

Imported records preserve stable identities, actor decisions, unresolved findings, relationships, original subject identities and assessment meaning; source format, original location and content identity remain attributable.
Unsupported historical formats remain archival and do not acquire runtime support or renewed approval; active work that depends on them blocks activation until a responsible disposition is recorded.
Required original bytes, uncommitted source content and required artifacts remain recoverable. Migrating records does not itself authorize source deletion; SR-024 governs retirement.

Changed source identity, interruption, conflicting destination content or an invalid final reference prevents partial activation and preserves sources and unrelated destination work. A retry cannot duplicate already imported identities or silently merge conflicts.
Activation identifies one authoritative operational destination and reconciles current readers and writers; no permanent dual-write or silent legacy fallback is established.

failure_behavior.condition: Required source, interpretation or scope integrity cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the specific gap without claiming completeness, inventing decisions or mutating unrelated work.

failure_behavior.condition: Selected source or destination changes before a mutating operation can complete.
failure_behavior.outcome: Preserve established work and report conflict or interruption; no silent overwrite or automatic semantic merge.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
Reconcile existing use/behavior with current explicit task selection, coherent SQLite outcomes and attributable judgments; no new stakeholder need or runtime qualification is inferred.
